#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <climits>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

class Maxflow {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int t, rev;
        long cap, f;
        Edge(int t, int rev, long cap) : t(t), rev(rev), cap(cap), f(0) {}
    };

    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;

    Maxflow(int n) {
        graph.resize(n);
    }

    void addEdge(int s, int t, long cap) {
        graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, (int)graph[t].size(), cap));
        graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, (int)graph[s].size() - 1, 0));
    }

    bool dinicBFS(int src, int dest, vector<int>& dist) {
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), -1);
        dist[src] = 0;
        queue<int> Q;
        Q.push(src);
        while (!Q.empty()) {
            int u = Q.front(); Q.pop();
            for (auto& e : graph[u]) {
                if (dist[e.t] < 0 && e.f < e.cap) {
                    dist[e.t] = dist[u] + 1;
                    Q.push(e.t);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[dest] >= 0;
    }

    long dinicDFS(vector<int>& ptr, vector<int>& dist, int dest, int u, long f) {
        if (u == dest) return f;
        for (; ptr[u] < (int)graph[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
            auto& e = graph[u][ptr[u]];
            if (dist[e.t] == dist[u] + 1 && e.f < e.cap) {
                long df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, e.t, min(f, e.cap - e.f));
                if (df > 0) {
                    e.f += df;
                    graph[e.t][e.rev].f -= df;
                    return df;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    long maxFlow(int src, int dest) {
        long flow = 0;
        vector<int> dist(graph.size());
        while (dinicBFS(src, dest, dist)) {
            vector<int> ptr(graph.size(), 0);
            while (true) {
                long df = dinicDFS(ptr, dist, dest, src, LLONG_MAX);
                if (df == 0) break;
                flow += df;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }
};

class MinCostFlowBF {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int to, f, cap, cost, rev;
        Edge(int to, int cap, int cost, int rev) : to(to), f(0), cap(cap), cost(cost), rev(rev) {}
    };

    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;

    MinCostFlowBF(int n) {
        graph.resize(n);
    }

    void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
        graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, cap, cost, (int)graph[t].size()));
        graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, 0, -cost, (int)graph[s].size() - 1));
    }

    void bellmanFord(int s, vector<int>& dist, vector<int>& prevnode, vector<int>& prevedge, vector<int>& curflow) {
        int n = (int)graph.size();
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INT_MAX);
        dist[s] = 0;
        curflow[s] = INT_MAX;
        vector<bool> inqueue(n, false);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        inqueue[s] = true;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            inqueue[u] = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[u].size(); i++) {
                auto& e = graph[u][i];
                if (e.f >= e.cap) continue;
                int v = e.to;
                int ndist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (dist[v] > ndist) {
                    dist[v] = ndist;
                    prevnode[v] = u;
                    prevedge[v] = i;
                    curflow[v] = min(curflow[u], e.cap - e.f);
                    if (!inqueue[v]) {
                        inqueue[v] = true;
                        q.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    vector<int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
        int n = (int)graph.size();
        vector<int> dist(n), curflow(n), prevedge(n), prevnode(n);
        int flow = 0, flowCost = 0;
        while (flow < maxf) {
            bellmanFord(s, dist, prevnode, prevedge, curflow);
            if (dist[t] == INT_MAX) break;
            int df = min(curflow[t], maxf - flow);
            flow += df;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                auto& e = graph[prevnode[v]][prevedge[v]];
                e.f += df;
                graph[v][e.rev].f -= df;
                flowCost += df * e.cost;
            }
        }
        return {flow, flowCost};
    }
};

class Task {
public:
    void solve() {
        int n, m, k, c, d;
        cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
        vector<int> pos(n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x; cin >> x;
            pos[x - 1]++;
        }
        const int T = 100;
        int totalNodes = (T + 1) * n + 2;
        MinCostFlowBF mf(totalNodes);
        int source = 0;
        int sink = (T + 1) * n + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (pos[i] > 0)
                mf.addEdge(source, i + 1, pos[i], 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                mf.addEdge(1 + i * n + j, 1 + (i + 1) * n + j, k, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                mf.addEdge(1 + i * n, (T + 1) * n + 1, 1, c * i);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a, b;
            cin >> a >> b;
            a--; b--;
            for (int j = 0; j < T; j++) {
                int cost = 0;
                for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                    int edgeCost = l * l * d - cost;
                    mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + a, 1 + (j + 1) * n + b, 1, edgeCost);
                    mf.addEdge(1 + j * n + b, 1 + (j + 1) * n + a, 1, edgeCost);
                    cost = l * l * d;
                }
            }
        }

        vector<int> flowAndCost = mf.minCostFlow(source, sink, k);
        cout << flowAndCost[1] << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Task t;
    t.solve();
    return 0;
}
